author: Aerosmith
body:
IGN: Aerosmith
Reason for Ban: Kill Aura
Appeal: This is my second time writing my ban appeal because after my first appeal in January, I was told to wait until it had been Five to Seven months after I was banned. Look, I definitely used Kill Aura, no denying it. And it was probably the worst thing I could've done because I lost my conncection with the whole community. I feel really badly for leaving the server that way, especially since I was planning on never really leaving at all. I'm sorry for my mistake. If you really feel that what I did is unforgivable, and you think that unbanning me would be a mistake, I understand. Thank you for taking the time to read this.

Aerosmith

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

After reviewing your punishment, I've come to the conclusion to deny your appeal. Mainly because you were well aware of the rules, and broke them anyways, knowing you will get banned permanently if you were caught. Thank you for you honesty though.

You may appeal in 2-3 months.

Best Regards,
Zeusy,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
